plain: Shortness, whether of time, speech, or writing.

webster.text: Shortness; applied to time; as the brevity of human life.

more.text: Shortness; conciseness; contraction into few words; applied to discourses or writings.

example.quote: I the rather consult brevity in discussing the probability of a preference founded upon a discrimination between the different kinds of industry and property, because, as far as I understand the meaning of the objectors, they contemplate a discrimination of another kind.
